cohort: Primiparous women born in Sweden 1973-1983 who gave birth in 2002-2004
finding: Women giving birth by CSMR had a higher prevalence of psychiatric disorders both before and after delivery compared to women who did not give birth by CSMR.
mod_finding: Women giving birth by CSMR had a higher prevalence of psychiatric disorders both before and after delivery compared to women who did not give birth by CSMR.
